It features a brilliant 1.3-in AMOLED touchscreen display paired with traditional button controls. product.title: Theragun Prime Plus Multi-Therapy Massage Gun
product.description: The Therabody Theragun Prime Plus is a multi-therapy handheld massage gun designed for runners, athletes, and active individuals to address muscle soreness and stiffness. It combines percussive therapy with adjustable heat, featuring a 2-in-1 Heated Percussive Plus Attachment along with three other attachments (Dampener, Standard Ball, and Wedge) for targeted treatment across different muscle groups. The device offers five speed settings and three heat levels, controllable via on-device LED controls. It features a patented ergonomic triangle handle with a textured grip for easy reach and a drop- and scratch-resistant construction for durability. Additionally, it integrates with the Therabody app for guided recovery routines.
